digest.component_or_area: CLI mutation verbs and output confirmation
propositions: Mutating CLI verbs currently exit 0 with empty stdout on success, making successful writes indistinguishable from idempotent no-ops, forcing agents to perform a follow-up store read to verify their own writes

Modern CLI practice requires every state change to be confirmed on stdout with a one-line message in past-tense verb form (e.g. 'created <alias> (<id>)', 'linked <src> -> <target>') with no-ops printed as 'no change: <reason>'

Global output flags --quiet/-q and --output/-o must be extracted at the top-level router before partition dispatch to support positional-only _REGISTRY leaf verbs (comment, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) that treat option-looking tokens as usage errors
Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must be normalized to a uniform confirmation contract preserving all data currently emitted without information loss
link's REDIRECT record emission must remain byte-identical before and after normalization on both write and no-op paths, including under --quiet, with exactly one stdout result per invocation

Under --output json, confirmations nest in a uniform mutation envelope {outcome, subject, detail} with existing consumed seam returns (e.g. add_dependency's dict | None) unchanged and verified by tests exercising the REDIRECT path
